name: DeepTutor
one_liner: An AI tutor that remembers what you've already learned and keeps adapting lessons to you over months, instead of starting from scratch every session like a chatbot.
buyer: An online tutoring company or test-prep business owner who wants to offer 'personal tutor that remembers you' as a paid subscription product instead of one-off chatbot sessions.
business_use_cases: A test-prep company (SAT/GMAT/language exams) white-labels it as the engine behind a 'your own AI tutor' subscription that tracks a student's weak spots across weeks.
A corporate L&D team runs it internally so new hires get a tutor that remembers their onboarding progress across modules instead of repeating the same intro content.
A homeschool parent runs it locally to give each of their kids a tutor that adapts to that specific child's pace and gaps over the school year.

money_ideas.idea: Sell monthly seats for a hosted, white-labeled version to tutoring centers and course creators.
Charge course platforms a per-student integration fee to bolt lifelong-memory tutoring onto their existing video courses.

steal_this: Point it at one narrow subject (e.g. just GMAT quant) and ship a branded landing page this weekend offering 'an AI tutor that never forgets your weak spots' as a $15/mo niche product.
